description: For a Robyn name or NULL handle the server must resolve it, so this reveals your intended recipient to the server — prefer robyn_message_directory when you have an address. Returns {address|handle, metaAddress, kemPub} (private-handle rows carry no address by design). Read-only.

addressOrName.description: 0x address, a NULL handle (e.g. alice.null), or label.robyn.id / .robynchain.eth / .rhood.eth

title: Messaging v2 — resolve a Robyn name to its mailbox
